headline: Canadian Federal Budget Projects GDP Expansion to $3.975 Trillion by 2030
summary: The Canadian federal budget outlined long-term economic growth targets, projecting gross domestic product to reach $3.975 trillion by 2030 through productivity and capital investment initiatives.
why: Federal budget releases set sovereign spending priorities, debt issuance expectations, and tax frameworks for Canada.

impacts.why: Budget proposals lay out long-term growth objectives for national economic output.
